text:
Anna - Partnerships: Quick kickoff — we need to align on engineering + GTM for the new sidecar-based Snowflake -> Qdrant connector and Databricks marketplace listing. Also need NVIDIA hardware cert for Dedicated nodes. Short sync please.
Mike - Solutions Eng: 👍 what's the minimum deliverable for marketplace? assets, sample app?
Jess - Product: Databricks marketplace wants a verified listing, 3 screenshots, deployment guide, and a 1-page one-pager. Snowflake listing similar but they also want an auth flow doc.
Rahul - Eng: For the sidecar ingest: we need to validate incremental sync semantics (CDC + TTL), connector should support backfill + realtime. Planning tests on a 10M-row table with 3GB of vectors.
Marina - PM: Timing ask from comms: we'd like joint announcement 3 weeks after eng sign-off. Can the cert + marketplace review be done in that window?
Anna - Partnerships: Tentative timeline: week 1 engineering POC + NVIDIA perf tests, week 2 packaging & docs, week 3 marketplace review + legal, aim for announcement EOD week 3. If any blockers, escalate.
Mike - Solutions Eng: I'll run the POC on a dedicated G4dn cluster and the infra partner will mirror on an A100 (NVIDIA). Heads-up: batch size tuning matters for latency.
Rahul - Eng: Test command for the POC (local dev):
```bash
# run sidecar ingest in dev mode
./connector --source snowflake --sink qdrant --mode incremental --test-dataset small_sample.csv
```
Also will add an opt-in flag for kv-cache to mimic production caching.
Jess - Product: For the marketplace artifacts I can draft the one-pager and screenshots. Need the connector UI flows — can someone grab screenshots from the console?
Mike - Solutions Eng: I can capture the console flow tomorrow. Will attach anonymized logs.
Marina - PM: Who's owning legal + data residency check for Snowflake listing? We must confirm we can list connector for EU customers.
Anna - Partnerships: @Jess and @Rahul coordinate on EU data residency. I'll loop in Legal once you have a short checklist.
Rahul - Eng: Quick note on schema evolution: we'll add a compatibility test that applies a column rename and type promotion to ensure no breaks.
partners-bot: Reminder: marketplace-docs checklist due in 5 business days.
Jess - Product: Can we also standardize the billing attribution string? Databricks wants a partner ID in the manifest. I'll send the template.
Anna - Partnerships: Good. Action items: Mike = POC infra + screenshots; Rahul = run incremental + schema tests + NVIDIA perf; Jess = marketplace docs + billing manifest; Marina = timeline + announce draft. Update by EOD Wednesday. :rocket:
